summary: Aether Holdings filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $10,998,532 of its common stock through agent Rodman Renshaw LLC. Shares trade on Nasdaq under ATHR; last sale price $3.19 on June 23, 2026. The ATM allows sales directly on Nasdaq or in negotiated transactions with a 3.0% commission to the agent. Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. No fixed-price offering, tender, or special situation is involved. Monitoring would focus on actual sales pace and potential dilution given the public float of ~$33 million.
